title: Meh.
text: Meh.. I bought the 2.3x8 runner. The colors are more muted in real life so for me it is too much beige. Also, this rug is very thin and the backing is extremely hard and slippery. You definitely need a pad. I wish I hadn't missed the return window. It's rolled up in a corner where it's been since the day it arrived.

description: Experience the stunning beauty and allure of this bohemian rug from Safavieh’s Madison Collection. Classic medallions and a distressed vintage look channel timeless rug designs, while bold colors and modern construction make it a contemporary darling. Fashionable mosaics of floral medallions are featured in lovely gradient hues without overpowering the room. A refined power-loomed construction ensures precise details and its enhanced luxurious synthetic polypropylene and polyester fibers guarantee a virtually non-shedding rug. Due to the low shedding, this rug holds up in high-traffic area of the homes and looks beautiful in the living room, bedroom, home office, dining room, foyer, or nursery.
